outcome: prevalence of diabetes mellitus in pregnancy
cohort: 4,320,778 maternal delivery records linked to their respective birth records from 2006 to 2019 in Canada
finding: There has been a rise in the prevalence of all types of diabetes mellitus in pregnancy in Canada over a 15-year period, with pregnancies complicated by any form of DM having higher rates of maternal and infant complications.
mod_finding: Pregnancies with any form of diabetes had higher rates of Caesarian delivery compared to pregnancies without diabetes.
